row.evidence: Guru's pricing page now offers only a custom package that lists "SSO, SCIM, and role-based access"; the help centre says Guru supports SCIM-based user and group provisioning, which requires SSO to be configured first.
row.notes: Quote-only: getguru.com/pricing no longer shows tiers or prices, only a custom-fit package ('not just a per-seat tool') scoped by sales, which includes SSO, SCIM and role-based access; the billing help page still mentions monthly or annual seat billing. New in 2026-09. SCIM 2.0 at https://api.getguru.com/api/scim/v2 with a SCIM username and token (Basic-style user:token, pasted colon-separated into Entra/OneLogin). Users and groups sync; removing a user in the IdP deletes them in Guru immediately and frees the seat for reassignment; SCIM does not populate profile fields (HRIS sync does). Okta's catalogue app does SAML and SCIM (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push) per Guru's guide, although the OIN listing only marks SWA; Entra and OneLogin use non-gallery/generic SCIM apps (the Entra gallery 'Guru' is a different company); Office 365 provisioning is not supported. SAML JIT ('Automatically add users') is an alternative. REST API (Basic auth user token) lists members, reads/updates profiles and manages groups and group membership, with team-member webhooks; no create/remove-user endpoint.

okta.notes: The OIN listing (last updated 2013) marks only SWA as a capability, but Guru's Okta guide adds this catalogue app with SAML setup instructions and a Provisioning > API Integration tab (Create, Update, Deactivate, Push Groups); the vendor guide is used for behaviour (see conflicts).

entra.notes: Non-gallery app with Guru's SCIM endpoint; the gallery app named Guru belongs to another company.

onelogin.notes: Generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML' app per vendor guide.

jumpcloud.notes: Vendor guide adds the JumpCloud catalogue app for SSO only; the SCIM overview lists JumpCloud among setup guides but no JumpCloud SCIM steps are given.
